basic_details.job_title: Chennai Port Authority Pilot Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Chennai Port Authority is filling 02 (Two) posts of Pilot (Class-I) in its Marine Department by direct recruitment, in the scale of pay of Rs.70000 – 200000 (Revised). Both posts are reserved, one for Scheduled Tribes (ST) and one for Scheduled Castes (SC). Candidates must hold a Certificate of Competency as Master of Foreign Going ship and one year of post-qualification experience as Master / Chief Officer of a foreign going ship. Applications are made through the online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Shipping, and the last date for receipt of applications is 4 January 2027.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 04.01.2027. Under Regulation 9 of the Chennai Port Trust Employees' (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, employees of the Board of any Major Port Authority who possess the prescribed qualifications and experience may also apply, provided their age does not exceed 55 years.

how_to_apply: Apply through the online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Shipping. The notice prints the address as http://www.chennaiport.gov.in.
Submit the application in the prescribed format attached to the notice as Annexure - I (Proforma of the Application).
Affix a self-attested passport size photograph on the application.

Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of Age / Date of Birth, Educational qualification and Experience, viz. CoC (Certificate of Competency) and CDC, and the Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority in the latest format prescribed by the Govt. of India.
Applications are to be submitted to: Deputy Conservator, Marine Department, Chennai Port Authority, No.1, Rajaji Salai, Chennai – 600 001.

Applicants already in service of Government / Semi-Government organisations / Public Sector Undertakings / Autonomous Bodies must apply through Proper Channel and submit an advance copy to Chennai Port Authority.
Applications must be received by 4 January 2027 (Last Date for receipt of application). The notice does not specify the mode of sending the application to the Deputy Conservator.
Name of the post applied for, name, sex, date of birth and present age, category (SC/ST/OBC/UR) and Father's / Husband's name
INDOS Number, and academic and professional qualifications (exam, year of passing, institute, class and percentage)
Details of the Master (FG) certificate: date of issue, validity and issuing authority
Sea service / post-qualification experience after the Master Mariner (FG) certificate: company, vessel name, rank, GRT and period
Port employment history: organisation, designation, pay scale, regular / ad-hoc / contract, period and nature of work
Appreciation / outstanding work done, residential address with e-mail and phone, Aadhar No., PAN No. and particulars of documents attached, followed by a signed declaration
Self-attested copies of certificates for Age / Date of Birth
Self-attested copies of Educational qualification and Experience certificates – CoC (Certificate of Competency) and CDC
Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority in the latest prescribed format
Self-attested passport size photo affixed on the application
No objection certificate from the organization, for candidates giving port employment history
important_instructions: Per Ministry letter No.A-12034/11/2015-PE-II dated 19.05.2020, no employee can be designated as a Pilot without prior authorization from the Central Government under the new guidelines. Major Port Authorities may use designations such as "Probationary Pilot" or "Trainee Pilot" until the person is authorized by the Central Government to Pilot vessels. In-service applicants must produce NOC / Vigilance clearance at the time of interview. Contact: 044-25360833, Fax: 044-25384012, e-mail: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: Chennai Port Authority is a Major Port Authority with its office at No.1, Rajaji Salai, Chennai – 600 001. This recruitment notice is issued by its General Administration Department and signed by the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority. The Pilot (Class-I) posts are in the Marine Department, headed for this recruitment by the Deputy Conservator, to whom applications are addressed.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following qualification and experience for Pilot (Class-I). The crucial date for determining eligibility and age is 04.01.2027 . Both vacancies are reserved: 1 for ST and 1 for SC, as printed in the notice. The upper age limit is 40 years as on 04.01.2027. Under Regulation 9 of the Chennai Port Trust Employees' (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, employees of the Board of any Major Port Authority who possess the prescribed qualifications and experience may also apply, provided their age does not exceed 55 years. The notice states that these concessions are admissible for all posts filled by Direct Recruitment as per Rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Pilot (Class-I) vacancies has Chennai Port Authority announced?
faq.answer: Chennai Port Authority has announced 02 posts of Pilot (Class-I) in the Marine Department: 1 reserved for ST and 1 for SC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Chennai Port Pilot (Class-I) post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 January 2027 (04.01.2027).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Chennai Port Pilot (Class-I)?
faq.answer: A Certificate of Competency as Master of Foreign Going ship issued by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt. of India, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry, along with one year of post-qualification experience as Master / Chief Officer of a foreign going ship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Chennai Port Pilot (Class-I)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 04.01.2027, with 05 years' concession for SC/ST and 03 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q5. Can employees of other Major Port Authorities apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Under Regulation 9, employees of the Board of any Major Port Authority with the prescribed qualifications and experience may apply, provided their age does not exceed 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of Chennai Port Pilot (Class-I)?
faq.answer: The post carries the scale of pay of Rs.70000 – 200000 (Revised).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Chennai Port Pilot (Class-I)?
faq.answer: Apply through the Ministry of Shipping's online Application Portal (OAP) in the Annexure - I format with self-attested certificates and photo; applications are addressed to the Deputy Conservator, Marine Department, Chennai Port Authority, No.1, Rajaji Salai, Chennai – 600 001.

faq.question: Q8. What must in-service candidates do?
faq.answer: Candidates in Government, Semi-Government, PSU or Autonomous Bodies must apply through Proper Channel, send an advance copy to Chennai Port Authority and produce NOC / Vigilance clearance at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will the selected candidate be designated Pilot immediately?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Per the Ministry's guidelines, Major Port Authorities may use designations such as "Probationary Pilot" or "Trainee Pilot" until the person is authorized by the Central Government to Pilot vessels.
